celestial.name: Celestial Data
celestial.description: Collection of celestial datasets for the J2000 epoch, derived from d3-celestial and distributed in GeoJSON, GeoPackage and CSV formats. This project page introduces the collection; its website provides dataset descriptions and downloads.

leaflet.name: leaflet-providersESP
leaflet.description: Leaflet plugin with configurations for cartographic layers and WMS/WMTS services provided by public agencies in Spain.

covid.name: Historical processed COVID-19 data for Spain
covid.description: Historical processed snapshot of ISCIII COVID-19 data used for maps and charts of Spain. The project is obsolete and no longer updated; the project website documents the archived dataset and CSV download.

bot.name: spain-munic-bot
bot.description: R code for generating maps of buildings and urban growth in Spanish municipalities. Automated posting is disabled; the project preserves its historical outputs.

countrycodes.name: Country codes and international organizations
countrycodes.description: Database of countries and territories, their codes under different standards and their membership in international organizations. The project page documents its CSV and JSON files and source references.

corona.name: Corona Atlas
corona.description: Historical project mapping international COVID-19 risk areas designated by German authorities. The project is discontinued; this source code documents its operation.

7egment.name: 7egment
7egment.description: Discontinued Pebble watch face based on a seven-segment display, with location and weather information.

bzel.name: Bzel
bzel.description: Discontinued Pebble watch face displaying minutes as digits, a moving dot or a fill in the bezel.

sfera.name: Sfera
sfera.description: Discontinued customizable watch face for Pebble Time Round.

textwatch.name: TextWatch Clima
textwatch.description: Discontinued Pebble watch face extending TextWatch with additional features, including weather.
